body.statement: Two external high-probability inputs are maintained separately from the changing-contact claim. First, uniformly only over \(P\in\mathfrak P_n^{\mathrm{band}}(r_n)\), \(\widehat{\mathcal B}_{\eta,n}\) covers \(\eta(P)\) with probability at least \(1-\alpha/4-o(1)\) and has sup-norm diameter at most \(2r_n\). Second, the centered cross-fitted score class \(\Psi_n\), indexed only by \(\mathcal D_n\times\mathcal G_n\), has envelope \(F_\psi\), uniformly bounded \(2+\delta_\psi\) moment, and entropy bounded by \(\log|\mathcal D_n|+C_\psi V_c\log(C_\psi/t)\). Given these external prerequisites, can the critical-cone obstacle handle be completed into one observable coverage construction for \(\widehat{\mathcal T}_{n,h_n}^{+}\), \(\widehat{\mathcal P}_{X,n}\), the family \(\{\widehat I_G:G\in\mathcal G_n\}\), and one common multiplier critical value such that \(\inf_{P\in\mathfrak P_n^{\mathrm{band}}(r_n)}P\{\mathcal T(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\subseteq\widehat{\mathcal T}_{n,h_n}^{+},\ P_X\in\widehat{\mathcal P}_{X,n},\ [\underline\theta_G,\overline\theta_G]\subseteq\widehat I_G\ \forall G\in\mathcal G_n\}\ge1-\alpha-o(1)\) along sequences on which zero-capacity contact sets and optimal flow faces change? The desired directed whole-set excess is \(O_P(r_n+\mathsf R\delta_n+\sqrt{(\log|\mathcal D_n|+\log(1/\alpha))/n})\), and the desired uniform leaf-endpoint excess is \(O_P(r_n/p_{\min,n}+\mathsf R\delta_n+\sqrt{(V_c\log n+\log|\mathcal D_n|+\log(1/\alpha))/(np_{\min,n})})\). These bounds shrink when their displayed terms vanish. Under the explicit balancing conditions \(Lh_n+Mh_n^\beta=O(r_n)\), \(\mathsf R\delta_n=O(r_n)\), and \(\sqrt{(\log|\mathcal D_n|+\log(1/\alpha))/n}=O(r_n)\), only the whole-set excess compresses to \(O_P(r_n)\); the leaf result retains the displayed uncompressed bound. As a corollary of the simultaneous event, \([\underline\theta_{\widehat G},\overline\theta_{\widehat G}]\subseteq\widehat I_{\widehat G}\) for every data-measurable \(\widehat G\in\mathcal G_n\), without conditioning on its selection rule.
body.justification: Conditional on an externally certified nuisance band and finite-net empirical-process controls, the open step is uniform graph differentiation and calibration of the obstacle program as zero-capacity contacts and optimal faces change.
body.gap: Firpo, Galvao, and Parker fix the feasible correspondence; Semenova treats finite-dimensional set-linear support boundaries; Fang and Santos supply a general derivative-aware bootstrap; Wei et al. treat a supplied finite family of point-identified subgroup effects. None constructs band-subclass-uniform whole-set and finite-VC leaf coverage for an estimated infinite-dimensional obstacle whose contacts can appear or disappear.
body.consumer: A successful construction would support an honest reanalysis of the reported ADJUVANT genomic subgroup signs and would dictate when the early mass-and-sign kill test passes.
